findings.title: Possible hard-coded credential

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'New-NSACMECertificateUser' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential.
